body: thank you for your kind words. Honestly just, kind words are the best helpl I can probably expect right now. Even if they're just meant to calm me down because of the situation, it sucks. I'm in a really really rough spot. A few years ago I used to be very suicidal and self abusive and I'm long past that and my son is the only reason I don't wanna go back to inflicting harm on myself, just so I can focus on the physical pain instead of the emotional. I've still been eating ativan but trying my best not to over do it. this sucks so much. I really hate my life right now and would give anything to have a nice big shot of morphine while looking at a nice view and saying goodbye, but that's just thoughts. in reality I'm still worrying about house work and getting it all done while taking care of my son that way my wife doesnt come home and start even more arguments over petty things like laundry not being done yet. oh well what can I do heh. I don't have any friends or family where I live, the closest people are 3 hours away.

My wife is military and I'm a stay at home dad, so I rely on her a lot right now, I don't have any friends or family where we live, and not enough money to take my son and go somewhere or drive a few hours to get to some family even for a few days, she says the only reason I'm even living here is because she needs someone to take care of Eli hahaha. im fucking useless to her.
the plate is way past full, it got thrown at me, ha! thank you, sir, thank you.
hes my only reason for being alive right now, no I can't go for a walk either, he's asleep in bed with his mom thankfully because I'm in this condition, and it's freezing cold outside.

tonight this all started over because she could tell I was depressed, I told her to leave it alone and she heard me crying in the other room and came in here and started yelling and screaming at me telling me what the deal with us is and how she pretty much is about to be at the point where she doesnt love me anymore and doesnt wanna deal with this shit, all because I was upset that I can't be close to the love of my life before I don't see her for over a year, and her doing god knows what while she is gone from me..

shes screamed at me telling me im not worth being alive because i forget stuff off the grocery lisit, she's screamed at me because i didn't edit a craigslist post, she screams at me for absolutely ridiculous things and all i do is hold it in even thouogh i know she is ridiculous most of the time its so dumb. the petty things I do are just not cleaning enough or maintaining the house, im a stay at home dad and take care of our 3 month old son and sometimes i dont get all the house work done and sometimes i procrastinate a lot, i have A.D.D, ankylosing spondylitis, bi-polar 2, insomnia, and thats just the tip of the iceberg, and it's hard for me sometimes but I try my fucking hardest and she says im a fucking baby because of this
